name: Taskmarket Browser
description: Discover public Taskmarket work, inspect a task, or list its public submission metadata. This skill is strictly read-only: it cannot create, claim, submit, accept, reject, fund, or pay for tasks.
author: @nicholasswhite

examples.prompt: Find five open Taskmarket bounties tagged AI, highest reward first.
List the public submissions for that Taskmarket task.

operation.description: Read-only operation: list_tasks, get_task, or list_submissions. Defaults to list_tasks.

task_id.description: Taskmarket task ID (0x plus 64 hexadecimal characters). Required for get_task and list_submissions; otherwise leave empty.

status.description: Optional list_tasks status: open, claimed, worker_selected, pending_approval, review, appealing, disputed, completed, expired, cancelled, or ALL. Defaults to open.

phase.description: Optional list_tasks phase: active, in_review, awaiting_settlement, or resolved.

mode.description: Optional list_tasks mode: bounty, claim, pitch, benchmark, auction, or ALL.

tags.description: Optional comma-separated Taskmarket tags for list_tasks.

min_reward_usdc.description: Optional minimum reward in USDC for list_tasks, with no more than six decimal places.

max_reward_usdc.description: Optional maximum reward in USDC for list_tasks, with no more than six decimal places.

deadline_hours.description: Optional positive whole-number deadline horizon in hours for list_tasks.

sort.description: Optional list_tasks sort: newest, reward_desc, reward_asc, or deadline_asc. Defaults to newest.

limit.description: Optional list_tasks result limit. Values are clamped to the public API range of 1 through 100. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor returned by an earlier list_tasks call.
